query:
UPDATE referendums SET 
  status = 'Certified',
  called_result = 'No',
  notes = 'RESULT OVERTURNED BY VIRGINIA SUPREME COURT (May 8, 2026):

The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the redistricting amendment on May 8, 2026, ruling that the ballot question was unconstitutionally misleading. The court found that the question failed to adequately inform voters that approval would allow the General Assembly — rather than the independent Virginia Redistricting Commission — to draw new congressional maps, effectively bypassing the commission voters created in 2020.

The court ruled 7-0 that the amendment could not take effect, and the current congressional maps drawn by the Virginia Redistricting Commission remain in place through the 2030 census.

Case: Youngkin v. Virginia State Board of Elections (May 8, 2026)
Sources: Virginia Mercury · NPR Politics (May 8, 2026)'
WHERE id = 1;
